behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: linear interpolation and default remain distinct
docDelivery: Explain nearest default, exact linear formula, validation order/empty return and immutable numeric sorting.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Extend percentile(values,p,options?) with options.method "nearest" (default, preserve existing) or "linear". Validate method first, unknown TypeError("method"), then p finite number0..1 or RangeError("p"), even for empty input; return null for valid empty input. Values finite numbers, dense array<=1000, sorting copy numerically. Nearest uses index max(0,ceil(p*n)-1). Linear uses x=p*(n-1), interpolate between floor/ceil indexes. Duplicate values allowed. Never mutate/frozen input. Options plain object or omitted; no undefined-method error (defaults).
independence: Explicit synthetic library contract; alternatives judged by observable exports and required integration, not reference-source matching.
